pages.text: When Fruits Delight is installed, its fruits can be brewed into Aqua Vitae to make matching Flavoring Essences. Each fresh essence bottle supplies one full casing/flavoring use.

pages.title: Fruit Essences I
pages.text: Peach, Pear, Mango, Lychee, Hawberry, Orange, Persimmon, Blueberry, and Lemon each make their matching essence.

pages.title: Fruit Essences II
pages.text: Hamimelon Slice, Pineapple, Mangosteen, Cranberry, Bayberry, Fig, Kiwi, and Durian each make their matching essence.
